prompts.shop: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D Unity cozy cat-puzzle game menu-button sprite, square 1024x1024 RGBA PNG. Create ONE perfectly front-facing circular cream button badge, centered at (512,512), outer diameter approximately 956 pixels (93.3% of canvas). Its face is flat pale vanilla #FFF4D8 with an even medium warm tan #AB8A6F outer rim approximately 42 pixels thick. Match a simple vector-drawn hint lightbulb button, with clean rounded forms, brown outlines #946740, golden honey #FFD15B accents, very restrained flat 2D illustration. The primary pictogram is centered within the circle, about 58% of the canvas width, generous cream breathing room around it, broad simple features readable when the entire button is just 60 pixels. Background outside the circle MUST be genuine transparent alpha. Crisp smooth antialiased edges. No separate ground/drop shadow (the game adds one), no text, no labels, no checkerboard, no background, no perspective, no metallic/glossy 3D, no texture/noise, no sparkles, no extra decorative objects. Subject: a charming miniature SHOP STOREFRONT pictogram. A small cream building with a broad rounded striped awning of honey yellow and cream, warm brown outline; three broad scallops along the awning bottom; a simple pale blue window on the left and a narrow brown-outlined cream door on the right, one low golden base. Make it visually as simple as a lightbulb or gear symbol. The entire storefront including awning fits within approximately x=210..814 and y=235..780, inside the cream circle. No sign lettering, no merchandise, no currency.
